title: LinkFile
description: A link file: one `[[game]]` table per build folder.

build.description: How CI makes the build folders. dyno does not run it.

schema_version.description: The file format version. Must equal the schema version this dyno reads.

BuildCommand.description:
How CI makes the build folders, such as the workflow that the dyno site's setup pull request
writes. dyno does not run it.

command.description:
The shell command that makes every build folder from a fresh checkout, run in this file's
folder.

LinkedGame.description: One build folder and the game it belongs to.

build.description: The build folder or .zip, relative to this file. Unique in the file.

id.description: The game's id on the dyno site, a UUID.

name.description: The game's name: the `--game` label when none is given.
